rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose description of something that reveals a deeper truth or insight, especially in formal or written contexts.

example.english: This research report is highly revelatory, making us reconsider our beliefs.
example.traditional: 呢份研究報告好有啟示性，令人重新諗自己嘅信念。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 jin4 gau3 bou3 gou3 hou2 jau5 kai2 si6 sing3 ling6 jan4 cung4 san1 nam2 zi6 gei2 ge3 seon3 nim6

rows.note: Use this for something prophetic or suggestive of future events, without necessarily implying the end of the world.

example.english: This novel is strongly revelatory, as if it had already foretold future changes in society.
example.traditional: 呢篇小說帶有強烈嘅預言性，似乎早已寫中社會將來嘅變化。
example.jyutping: ne1 pin1 siu2 syut3 daai3 jau5 koeng4 lit6 ge3 jyu6 jin4 sing3 ci5 fu4 zou2 ji5 se2 zung3 se5 wui2 zoeng1 loi4 ge3 bin3 faa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the apocalyptic or doomsday slice of the meaning, rather than for prophecy in general.

example.english: That documentary uses a revelatory doomsday tone to describe how the city collapses in a disaster.
example.traditional: 嗰套紀錄片用末日式口吻，描寫城市點樣喺災難中崩潰。
example.jyutping: go2 tou3 gei2 luk6 pin2 jung6 mut6 jat6 sik1 hau2 man5 miu4 se2 sing4 si5 dim2 joeng2 hai2 zoi1 naan6 zung1 bang1 kui2
